notes: Two ideal point sources have a one-mask-unit horizontal gap. Under equal in-phase illumination the first horizontal null is at u one-half.
The gap turns: 0.6 across and 0.8 up have length one. Under equal in-phase point illumination, the first null satisfies 0.6u + 0.8v = one-half.
The one-unit gap is vertical now. Under equal in-phase point illumination the first vertical null is at v one-half; a horizontal profile need not show it.
